Core collaboration hours are 10:30 AM – 4:30 PM, during which employees are expected to be available. ## 2. Probation Period All new hires undergo a probation period of **3 months** from their date of joining. Confirmation is based on a performan

e of joining. Confirmation is based on a performance review conducted by the reporting manager. ## 3. Attendance Employees must log attendance via the HR portal daily. Repeated unexplained absences or persistent late logins may result in a formal HR review. ## 4. Communication Channels - Official communication and approvals: company email. - Day-to-day team communication: Slack/WhatsApp as designa

-day team communication: Slack/WhatsApp as designated by each team. - Formal HR requests (leave, reimbursement, grievance): HR portal only. ## 5. Grievance Redressal Employees may raise workplace concerns confidentially with HR via the grievance email or in-person request for a meeting. HR commits to acknowledging any grievance within 2 working days. ## 6. Code of Conduct Employees are expected to

eeding into compensation revisions and promotion decisions. ## 8. Reimbursements Approved business expenses (client travel, approved training) are reimbursed within 15 working days of submitting receipts through the HR portal.

# Zevoir Technologies — Leave Policy ## 1. Casual Leave All confirmed employees are entitled to **12 casual leaves per calendar year**, credited at the rate of 1 per month. Casual leave must be applied for at least 1 day in advance via the HR portal, except in genuine emergencies. Casual leave cannot be carried forward to the next year and lapses on 31 December. ## 2. Sick Leave Employees are enti

n 31 December. ## 2. Sick Leave Employees are entitled to **8 sick leaves per calendar year**. For sick leave exceeding 2 consecutive days, a medical certificate must be submitted to HR within 3 working days of returning to work. Sick leave cannot be combined with casual leave in the same request without HR approval. ## 3. Earned/Annual Leave Confirmed employees accrue **1.5 earned leave days per

rmed employees accrue **1.5 earned leave days per month** (18 days per year), credited at the start of each quarter. Earned leave may be carried forward up to a maximum of 30 days. Earned leave requests must be submitted at least 7 days in advance and require manager approval. ## 4. Leave Request Process 1. Log the leave request on the HR portal or notify your manager directly for casual leave und

Leave balances are visible on the HR portal at all times. 4. Unapproved absences will be marked as Leave Without Pay (LWP). ## 5. arately by the Zevoir Technologies Holiday Calendar document and are not deducted from any leave balance. ## 6. Maternity & Paternity Leave Maternity leave: **12 weeks** paid leave for confirmed female employees, as per statutory guidelines. Paternity leave: **5 working days** paid leave for confirmed male employees, to be availed within 1 month of the child's birth.

# Zevoir Technologies — Work From Home (WFH) Policy ## 1. Eligibility All confirmed employees who have completed their probation period are eligible to request Work From Home. Interns and employees on probation require explicit manager approval for any WFH request. ## 2. Standard WFH Allowance Employees may work from home up to **4 days per month**, subject to manager approval and no critical in-o

, subject to manager approval and no critical in-office meetings scheduled that day. ## 3. Ad-Hoc / Situational WFH For situational reasons such as feeling unwell, minor personal emergencies, or public transport disruptions, employees may request a single-day WFH by informing their manager as early as possible on the same day, ideally before 9:30 AM. This does not require submission through the HR

Notification Requirement All WFH requests, whether planned or ad-hoc, must be communicated to the direct manager in advance or as early as possible on the day of WFH, along with expected availability during work hours. ## 5.
